mapper.select: SELECT -1 AS Id, '巡视设备' AS label, 0 AS upId, '' AS upName, '' AS infoType UNION( SELECT dict_code AS Id, dict_note AS label, -1 AS upId, '巡视设备' AS upName, '' AS infoType FROM t_dict_business WHERE col_name = 'cruise_device_type' ) UNION( SELECT robot_id AS Id, robot_name AS label, 870 AS upId, '机器人' AS upName, "robot" AS infoType FROM t_robot_info WHERE drone_type is null ) UNION ( SELECT robot_id AS Id, robot_name AS label, 871 AS upId, '无人机' AS upName, "drone" AS infoType FROM t_robot_info WHERE robot_type is null ) UNION ( SELECT camera_id AS Id, camera_name AS label, 872 AS upId, '摄像机' AS upName, "camera" AS infoType FROM t_camera_info ) UNION ( SELECT record_id AS Id, record_name AS label, 873 AS upId, '录像机' AS upName, "record" AS infoType FROM t_camera_recorder ) UNION ALL ( SELECT voice_device_id AS Id, voice_device_name AS label, 874 AS upId, '声纹' AS upName, "voice" AS infoType FROM t_voice_device )
